Hashes below identify the checked-in files. License text has only whitespace
normalization compared with the referenced upstream license files.

- `json.LICENSE`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/LICENSE.MIT, SHA256 `c0d068392ea65358b798b8c165103560f06e9e3b38c4ab4e2d8810a7b931af86`

Splash's Apache-2.0 license and original third-party notices accompany the
adapted norm reduction and DeltaNet lane mapping in `src/native/metal`.
